title: Shoreline: swap the margin
text: T-3553 shoreline: swap the 12 m margin for reading the water mask between cells (about 1 h)? Narrow city rivers then count as water across 69-75% of their width instead of 55-60%; shore forgiveness about the same. Pick: swap. Separately, NYC and 8 other US packs use TIGER water that is up to 116-178 m off around Brooklyn's piers; OSM water instead is about 2 h plus a water rebuild of those 9 packs, and moves track prices there. Pick: queue it for a night run.

title: Trains drawn apart: the look
text: T-3264 stage 1: trains in opposite directions on double track drawn side by side from zoom 14 (artifacts/trainworld/review/t3264-before.png and t3264-after.png; Midtown rows in t3264-midtown.png). Does it look right? On shared track the trains get thin: keep the strict thin version, a 4 px floor, or leave shared track for a later stage that widens bands? Pick: the 4 px floor.
